title: No pharmacist may fill a multiple Schedule II prescription before its indicated date
subtopic: Earliest fill date on multiple Schedule II prescriptions
rule_summary: Under 21 CFR 1306.14(e), where a prescription that has been prepared in accordance with 21 CFR 1306.12(b) contains instructions from the prescribing practitioner indicating that the prescription shall not be filled until a certain date, no pharmacist may fill the prescription before that date.
exam_relevance: Tests the pharmacist's own duty on a prescription prepared under 21 CFR 1306.12(b): where the practitioner's instructions say it shall not be filled until a certain date, no pharmacist may fill it before that date.
common_confusions: The instruction is written by the prescribing practitioner; the prohibition on filling before the indicated date binds the pharmacist.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1306.14 on 2026-09-14.
